text: I think I will be able to change universities!!! I still have to send some documents, but they accepted me. I won't know until August if I am really in. I am excited and a little nervous about it.
Just finished Part 5, Volume 11 of Ascendance of a Bookworm. Might start Volume 12 tonight.

My options were limited from the start, but I got into two of my top choices. The last email arrived early this morning. I want to study Computer Systems Engineering (it is basically the equivalent of Computer Science in my country) since it fits my goals better, but I also got into a more prestigious university for Web Development, and I don’t really want to let that opportunity go.

I think I will try both this semester and see how it goes. My main goal is to maintain a good GPA; and if I can’t manage both... I don’t know. I won’t think about it too much for now.

One war is over and another is starting. It feels like a weight I’ve been carrying for a long time is finally gone. I have a university to go to now!! (*￣▽￣)b
